notes.title: Upcoming permanent price reduction for Earth Attack plus new updates coming!
notes.notes:
Hello, defenders of Earth! 

We are talking to Valve about permanently reducing the price of the game to $3 USD and the equivalent amount in other currencies.  When they get back to us if it is ok to reduce the price like this despite being so soon after the summer sale, we will set the price change in motion. We might have to wait a while, but we will keep you posted.

In addition to that announcement, we plan to update the game more regularly with some of the suggestions made in comments we've gathered from reviews or comments on the YouTube video.  

Some of the ideas we have or you all shared include new mechanics (black holes, gravity wells that influence trajectories and enemy paths, new weapon types with different behaviors, dynamic/active shield meter that can be charged by powerups), online leaderboards [not sure if we can use Steam's built-in leaderboards as the engine this game was made in doesn't have much support for any recent versions of the Steam API, but we could use a different provider like GameJolt, or a different one if you all would prefer some other option], and potentially more based upon your feedback to this announcement. 

Beyond the new mechanics and features, we are considering a stylistic overhaul to use a more unified set of designs.  What sort of changes would you like to see?   Share in the comments and we will make some polls to see what order your ideas will get developed.   We plan to make updates around once or twice a month as we finish features.  

By the way, since no one wanted to try our other prototypes, we decided to delist them from Steam on August 1st, 2023.  They are all 80% off for the next two weeks if you care.  Either way, we would like to focus on this and other more interesting projects.

Thanks for your interest and time,

PTW Inc.

notes.title: Markiplier Thank You Update And Sale
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=yVq3MQSUNmk;full]https://youtu.be/yVq3MQSUNmk[/previewyoutube]

Thanks to [b][i]Markiplier[/i][/b] for being the first person to ever try the game out and provide some feedback!  We are working on updates that will include boss battles, more events to add excitement, and an improved gameplay loop thanks to his suggestions in his video titled "I Let a Sketchy Website Pick a Random Steam Game for Me to Play" so check that out if you're interested to laugh at our mistakes!  Hopefully, we can improve [i]Earth Attack[/i] to be worthy of his glorious positive review!

Let us know what sort of changes you'd like to see to the game and we will do our best to implement them soon.  Also, don't forget to check out some of our other prototypes that are all currently on sale for 80% Off Until September 4th!
